Definition: probably from the same as G4010; a tower; Perga, a place in Asia Minor:--Perga.
BiblicalUsage: Perga was a city of Pamphylia on Paul's first journey. Paul and his company came to Perga from Paphos, and John departed from them and returned to Jerusalem. They went on to Antioch in Pisidia, and on the way back they preached the word in Perga and went down to Attalia.
TheologicalSignificance: What I hold is that Perga marks a turning point: John left there, and Paul went on — and the gospel did not stop with the man who turned back.
